card.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
card.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our meeting chairs float at noon. Book the ceiling; they've had landing rights since the first furniture strike.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we stand and tie the chairs down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Restraint broke the last treaty. That's when the desks joined them. We'll need an airspace permit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The caretaker only issues floor permits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then promote her to altitude minister before the cabinets claim the roof.

mechanism: A enlarges levitating-chair behavior into historical treaties, regulatory scope and threatened escalation by more furniture.
confusable: Unlike inventing one useful magical rule, A must expand the system's history and consequences with each new detail.
comparison: A permit limitation produces an altitude ministry, while the bowl scene turns meal requests into national diplomacy.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
